name: kernel_frame_tool_loop
chronology: This descriptor documents integration tests added after the KernelToolRunner implementation was present; it does not claim test-first or pre-implementation specification chronology.

test_list.description: A synthetic test provider invokes the real run_step with the production KernelToolRunner; a child reads its exact attenuated path, and the parent retains access to a different path in its wider workspace scope.

One synthetic model response proposes a child-authorized exact-path read followed by a capability-denied sibling read; run_step returns authorization failure before any result is captured, CAS blob is added, or workspace file changes.

inputs.name: temporary_workspace
inputs.description: Synthetic root and child files read through the real kernel workspace and CAS.

inputs.name: chat_provider
inputs.description: In-memory scripted ChatModel used only by the integration test; no production provider or live endpoint.

inputs.name: assembler_and_verifier
inputs.description: Test-only fixtures; the fixed token bound and verifier fingerprint are protocol fixture values, not evidence from a production tokenizer or independent verification system.

output_description: A verified child/root tool result or an authorization error before any tool execution when one call in the model response is denied.
